product_one_liner.value: Smallest.ai provides real-time speech recognition, speech synthesis, and conversational voice agents for enterprises building and automating voice interactions.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 104 employees; its broader company-size category is 51–200.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts cover Lightning inference optimization on Tenstorrent, by Senior AI Inference Performance Engineer Ranjith M S, and real-time voice-stack architecture, by co-founder/CTO Akshat Mandloi.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists three roles: Manager - Finance and Accounts, Senior SDET, and Software Engineer - Systems and Reliablity; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.value: OpenAI GPT-4o and Smallest.ai Electron models; proprietary Pulse speech-to-text, Lightning text-to-speech, and Hydra speech-to-speech models.
model_provider.notes: The Atoms FAQ explicitly lists GPT-4o and Electron; the homepage describes the proprietary speech models.

compliance_certs.notes: These are public compliance claims, not independent verification. The Trust Center labels its SOC 2 Type II report expired in August 2026, despite continuing to display the badge and the FAQ certification claim; HIPAA availability is qualified to enterprise accounts in the FAQ.

last_funding.notes: The July 30, 2026 press release distinguishes the $13 million round from total funding exceeding $21 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The $13 million Series A announced July 30, 2026 falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: None of the three currently listed positions is an SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: On July 30, 2026, the company introduced Voice 4.0 and Hydra, its asynchronous speech-to-speech architecture/model, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Siddharth Sharma joined as President – BFSI, India in October 2026; the appointment was announced October 26. This treats a business-unit President as VP-level or above; his profile categorizes the role as President/Vice President.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are explicitly named product integrations, not evidence that Smallest.ai internally uses them as its own CRM stack.
